definition: all day and all night without stopping
description: A big workshop with brick walls and roof windows, where a team builds a giant red and gold dragon sculpture on a wooden platform. A young woman in dungarees paints its head from a ladder, climbs down, then climbs back up and paints again. A man sands its side and a young woman in a green jumper yawns and drinks from a coffee cup. Two more workers sleep on the concrete floor among paint tins, coffee cups and a pizza box, and pale pink dawn light shows through the windows.

taps.phrase: to doze on a blue cushion
